Raw Data
```{r}
# (named tab_names, not "sheets": openxlsx has its own sheets() function, which causes clashes)
tab_names <- as.character(excel_sheets(opihi_file_in))
print(tab_names)   # the tab names R actually sees

find_sheet <- function(kind, p) {
  up  <- str_to_upper(tab_names)
  hit <- tab_names[str_detect(up, paste0("^", kind)) & str_detect(up, p)]
  if (length(hit) != 1)
    stop("Expected exactly 1 '", kind, " ... ", p, "' tab, found ", length(hit),
         ". Tabs in file: ", paste(tab_names, collapse = " | "))
  hit
}

sh_t1 <- "TRANSECT PT INTERCEPT (P1)"
sh_t2 <- "TRANSECT PT INTERCEPT (P2)"
sh_q1 <- "QUADRAT PT INTERCEPT (P1)"
sh_q2 <- "QUADRAT PT INTERCEPT (P2)"
 
# ---------- 1. RAW DATA ONLY ----------
# Transect sheets: header on row 4, 7 points on rows 5-11, columns A:I.
# Everything right of column I is compiled/summary data, so it is skipped.
read_transect <- function(sheet) {
  read_excel(opihi_file_in, sheet = sheet, range = "A4:I11") |>
    rename(Point = 1, Location_m = 2) |>
    pivot_longer(-c(Point, Location_m), names_to = "Group", values_to = "Original") |>
    filter(!is.na(Original)) |>
    mutate(Original = as.character(Original),
           Method = "Transect", Site = str_sub(Group, 1, 2), Points = 1)
}

# Quadrat sheets: header on row 5, organisms start row 6, columns A:H.
# Stop at the "TOTAL Points" row; the TOTALS column (I) and % columns (J:K) are never read.
read_quadrat <- function(sheet) {
  df <- read_excel(opihi_file_in, sheet = sheet, range = "A5:H40") |> rename(Original = 1)
  stop_at <- which(str_detect(df$Original, "TOTAL Points"))[1]
  df[seq_len(stop_at - 1), ] |>
    filter(!is.na(Original)) |>                      # drop empty template rows
    pivot_longer(-Original, names_to = "Group", values_to = "Points") |>
    mutate(Points = replace_na(as.numeric(Points), 0))|>
    filter(Points > 0) |>                            # blank = 0 points
    mutate(Method = "Quadrat", Site = str_sub(Group, 1, 2), Location_m = NA_real_)
}


# 'GROUP DATA' is an empty template and 'P1 & P2 TRANSECT' is all formulas,
# so neither has raw data.
stacked <- bind_rows(
  read_transect(sh_t1),
  read_transect(sh_t2),
  read_quadrat(sh_q1),
  read_quadrat(sh_q2)
)
```

Name
```{r}

# Transect sheets: NAME in row 3 (C:I), group codes in row 4.
# Quadrat sheets:  NAME / CHECKER #1 / CHECKER #2 in rows 2-4 (B:H), group codes in row 5.
read_names_transect <- function(sheet) {
  nm <- read_excel(opihi_file_in, sheet = sheet, range = "C3:I4", col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text")
  tibble(Method = "Transect",
         Group = as.character(unlist(nm[2, ])),
         Recorder = as.character(unlist(nm[1, ])),
         Checker_1 = NA_character_, Checker_2 = NA_character_)
}
read_names_quadrat <- function(sheet) {
  nm <- read_excel(opihi_file_in, sheet = sheet, range = "B2:H5", col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text")
  tibble(Method = "Quadrat",
         Group = as.character(unlist(nm[4, ])),
         Recorder = as.character(unlist(nm[1, ])),
         Checker_1 = as.character(unlist(nm[2, ])),
         Checker_2 = as.character(unlist(nm[3, ])))
}
names_tbl <- bind_rows(
  read_names_transect(sh_t1),
  read_names_transect(sh_t2),
  read_names_quadrat(sh_q1),
  read_names_quadrat(sh_q2)
) |> mutate(across(c(Recorder, Checker_1, Checker_2), str_squish))

```


Clean Labels
```{r}
# Lookup key = trimmed, lower-case original. Edit this map to change any decision.
clean_map <- c(
  "rock" = "Rock", "sand" = "Sand",
  "turf algae" = "Turf algae", "turf" = "Turf algae",
  "padina spp" = "Padina spp.", "padina spp." = "Padina spp.",
  "acanthophora spicifera" = "Acanthophora spicifera",
  "dendropoma gregarium" = "Dendropoma gregarium",
  "sargassum polyphylum" = "Sargassum polyphyllum",
  "sargassum polyphyllum" = "Sargassum polyphyllum",
  "saragassum polyphylum" = "Sargassum polyphyllum",
  "sargassum aquifolium" = "Sargassum aquifolium",
  "sr aquifolium" = "Sargassum aquifolium",          # assumed: Sr = Sargassum
  "turbinaria ornata" = "Turbinaria ornata",
  "turbinania ornata" = "Turbinaria ornata",
  "neomeris" = "Neomeris spp.", "neomeris spp." = "Neomeris spp.",
  "bornatella sphaerica" = "Bornetella sphaerica",
  "bornatella spaerica" = "Bornetella sphaerica",
  "byropsis pennata" = "Bryopsis pennata",
  "caiclmus laevimanus" = "Calcinus laevimanus",    # assumed typo (hermit crab)
  "halimeda discoidea" = "Halimeda discoidea",
  "halimeda discodia" = "Halimeda discoidea",
  "avrainvilea sp." = "Avrainvillea sp.",
  "unknown snail" = "Unknown snail",
  "unknown fish" = "Unknown fish",
  "y" = "Unidentified"                              # stray entry, not guessed
)
substrates <- c("Rock", "Sand")
 
clean_label <- function(x) {
  key <- str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
  out <- unname(clean_map[key])
  ifelse(is.na(out), str_squish(x), out)            # unmapped labels are just trimmed
}
 
stacked <- stacked %>%
  mutate(Label = clean_label(Original),
         Type  = if_else(Label %in% substrates, "Substrate", "Organism"))
```

```{r}
# Quadrat rows that collapse to the same label are added together
# (e.g. "Sargassum aquifolium" + "Sr aquifolium").
opihi_long <- bind_rows(
  stacked |>filter(Method == "Transect"),
  stacked |> filter(Method == "Quadrat") |>
    group_by(Method, Site, Group, Label, Type) |>
    summarise(Points = sum(Points),
              Original = paste(unique(Original), collapse = "; "),
              Location_m = NA_real_, .groups = "drop")
) |>
  left_join(names_tbl, by = c("Method", "Group")) |>
  arrange(Method, Site, Group, Location_m, Label) |>
  mutate(site = "Diamond Head", school = "X high school") |>
  select(school, school, site, method = Method, p1_or_p2 = Site, 
         group = Group,
         recorder = Recorder, checker_1 = Checker_1, checker_2 = Checker_2,
         transect_points = Location_m, organism_substrate = Label,
         type = Type, points = Points, organism_label = Original)

opihi_long <- janitor::clean_names(opihi_long)

glimpse(opihi_long)
write_csv(opihi_long, here("Mai", "data", "opihi_master_long.csv"), na = "")
```

```{r}
# label map - documents everything
notes <- c("Sr aquifolium" = "Assumed 'Sr' = Sargassum.",
           "Caiclmus laevimanus" = "Assumed typo of Calcinus laevimanus (hermit crab).",
           "Bornatella sphaerica" = "Genus spelled Bornetella.",
           "Bornatella spaerica" = "Genus spelled Bornetella; species typo.",
           "y" = "Stray entry in P2 transect (P2G3, 6 m). Left as Unidentified.",
           "Turf" = "Assumed Turf algae.",
           "Neomeris" = "Merged with Neomeris spp.")

opihi_label_map <- stacked |>
  distinct(Original, Label) |>
  mutate(Changed = if_else(Original != Label, "Yes", ""),
         Note = unname(notes[str_squish(Original)]),
         Note = replace_na(Note, "")) |>
  arrange(Label, Original)|>
  rename(original = Original, cleaned_label = `Label`, changed = Changed, note = Note)
 
write_csv(opihi_long, here("Mai", "data", "opihi_label_map.csv"), na = "")
```

```{r}
#Insert files 

file_0607 <- here("Mai", "data", "OPIHI data 2006 and 2007.xlsx")

file_csv  <- here("Mai", "data", "opihi_long_2006_2007.csv")
 
# read data as a text
raw <- read_excel(file_0607, 
                  sheet = 1, 
                  col_names = FALSE, 
                  col_types = "text")

m <- as.matrix(raw)  # rows x columns, everything is character
 
# Each survey is a block of columns that starts where row 1 says "Date".
# In every block:  rows 1-11 = info (date, location, lat, long, school) in the column after the label
#row 13 = quadrat headers ("transect-1 quadrat-1 at point 1.00")
#rows 14-60 = organism names (first column of block) and counts
#rows 61+  = TOTALS section (skipped: not raw data)
starts <- which(m[1, ] == "Date")
ends   <- c(starts[-1] - 1, ncol(m))
 
# helpers
to_date <- function(x) { # Excel dates arrive as serial numbers when read as text
  d <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (!is.na(d)) as.Date(d, origin = "1899-12-30") else as.Date(substr(x, 1, 10))
}
 
read_block <- function(c0, c1) {
  info_col <- c0 + 1
  cols <- (c0 + 1):c1
  cols <- cols[!is.na(m[13, cols])]                                   # only columns with a quadrat header
  rows <- 14:60
  rows <- rows[!is.na(m[rows, c0]) & m[rows, c0] != ""]               # only rows with an organism name
 
  body <- as.data.frame(m[rows, cols, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(body) <- paste0("c", seq_along(cols))
  body$original_labels <- m[rows, c0]
  header <- m[13, cols]
 
  body |>
    pivot_longer(-original_labels, names_to = "col", 
                 values_to = "points") |>
    mutate(points = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(points))) |>
    filter(!is.na(points), points > 0) |>   # blank = not observed
   mutate(header = header[as.integer(str_remove(col, "^c"))],
           date      = to_date(m[1, info_col]),
           site      = m[8, info_col],
           latitude  = as.numeric(m[9, info_col]),
           longitude = as.numeric(m[10, info_col]),
           school    = m[11, info_col],
           number_of_transect_lines = as.numeric(m[4, info_col]),
           length_of_transect_lines = as.numeric(m[5, info_col]),
           point_spacing            = m[6, info_col],
           number_of_quadrats_per_transect = as.numeric(m[7, info_col]),
           transect  = as.integer(str_match(header, "transect-(\\d+)")[, 2]),
           quadrat   = as.integer(str_match(header, "quadrat-(\\d+)")[, 2]),
           transect_points = as.numeric(str_match(header, "point ([0-9.]+)")[, 2]))
}
 
# stack
stacked <- bind_rows(Map(read_block, starts, ends))
 
# clean labels - (same names as the 2023 cleanup where they match) 
clean_map <- c(
  "turf spp"            = "Turf algae",          # assumed: Turf spp = turf algae
  "padina spp"          = "Padina spp.",
  "neomeris spp"        = "Neomeris spp.",
  "dendropoma gregaria" = "Dendropoma gregarium"
)
substrates <- c("Rock", "Sand")
 
clean_label <- function(x) {
  key <- str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
  out <- unname(clean_map[key])
  ifelse(is.na(out), str_squish(x), out)
}
 

opihi_0607 <- stacked |>
  mutate(organism_substrate = clean_label(original_labels),
         type   = if_else(organism_substrate %in% substrates, 
                          "Substrate", "Organism"),
         method = "Quadrat",
         p1_or_p2 = NA_character_, 
         group = NA_character_,# not in this dataset
         recorder = NA_character_, checker_1 = NA_character_, 
         checker_2 = NA_character_) |>
  arrange(date, site, transect, quadrat, organism_substrate) |>
  select(school, site, method, p1_or_p2, group, 
         recorder, checker_1, checker_2,
         transect_points, organism_substrate, type, points, original_labels,
         date, latitude, longitude,
         number_of_transect_lines, length_of_transect_lines, point_spacing,
         number_of_quadrats_per_transect, transect, quadrat)

write_csv(opihi_0607,here("Mai","data","opihi_long_2006_2007.csv"), na = "")

# To filter to one site later:  opihi_0607 |> filter(site == "Diamond Head")

```



```{r}
#Insert files 

opihi_16_file <- here("Mai", "data", "opihi_16_data.xlsx")      
opihi_16_file_out  <- here("Mai", "data", "opihi_long_2016.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(opihi_16_file))
 
# Read Sheet as Text 
# rows x columns, everything is character
m <- as.matrix(read_excel(opihi_16_file, 
                          sheet = 1, col_names = FALSE, 
                          col_types = "text"))

# Each survey is a block of columns that starts where row 1 says "Date".
starts <- which(m[1, ] == "Date")
ends   <- c(starts[-1] - 1, ncol(m))
if (length(starts) == 0)
  stop("No 'Date' cell found in row 1 - wrong file or sheet? 
       First cells read: ",
       paste(head(m[1, ], 3), collapse = " | "))


#Helpers
clean_map <- c("turf spp" = "Turf algae", 
               "padina spp" = "Padina spp.",
               "neomeris spp" = "Neomeris spp.", 
               "dendropoma gregaria" = "Dendropoma gregarium")

clean_label <- function(x) {
  out <- unname(clean_map[str_to_lower(str_squish(x))])
  ifelse(is.na(out), str_squish(x), out)
}

to_date <- function(x) {# Excel dates arrive as serial numbers when read as text
  d <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (!is.na(d)) as.Date(d, origin = "1899-12-30") else as.Date(substr(x, 1, 10))
}
# Excel serial -> date)

#Read one survey block
read_block <- function(c0, c1) {
  info <- c0 + 1             # info values sit in the column after the label
  cols <- (c0 + 1):c1
  cols <- cols[!is.na(m[13, cols])]  # columns with a quadrat header (row 13)
  totals_row <- which(m[, c0] == "TOTALS:")[1] # TOTALS section = not raw data
  rows <- 14:(totals_row - 2) # organism rows end 2 rows above TOTALS
  rows <- rows[!is.na(m[rows, c0]) & m[rows, c0] != ""]
  if (length(cols) == 0 || length(rows) == 0) return(NULL) # empty survey (e.g. Kahana Bay)
 
  body <- as.data.frame(m[rows, cols, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(body) <- paste0("c", seq_along(cols))
  body$original_labels <- m[rows, c0]
  header <- m[13, cols]

  body |>
    pivot_longer(-original_labels, names_to = "col", 
                 values_to = "points") |>
    mutate(points = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(points))) |>
    filter(!is.na(points), points > 0) |>   # blank = not observed
    mutate(header = header[as.integer(str_remove(col, "^c"))],
           date      = to_date(m[1, info]),
           site      = m[8, info],
           latitude  = as.numeric(m[9, info]),
           longitude = as.numeric(m[10, info]),
           school    = str_squish(m[11, info]),
           number_of_transect_lines        = as.numeric(m[4, info]),
           length_of_transect_lines        = as.numeric(m[5, info]),
           point_spacing                   = m[6, info],
           number_of_quadrats_per_transect = as.numeric(m[7, info]),
           transect = as.integer(str_match(header, "transect-(\\d+)")[, 2]),
           quadrat = as.integer(str_match(header, "quadrat-(\\d+)")[, 2]),
           transect_points = as.numeric
           (str_match(header,"point ([0-9.]+)")[, 2]))
}

blocks <- Map(read_block, starts, ends)
if (all(vapply(blocks, is.null, logical(1))))
  stop("Every survey block came back empty (", length(starts), " blocks found).")

# Stack + opihi format
opihi_2016 <- bind_rows(blocks) |>
  mutate(organism_substrate = clean_label(original_labels),
         type     = if_else(organism_substrate %in% 
                              c("Rock", "Sand"), "Substrate", "Organism"),
         method   = "Quadrat",
         p1_or_p2 = NA_character_, group = NA_character_,
         # not in this dataset
         recorder = NA_character_, checker_1 = NA_character_, 
         checker_2 = NA_character_) |>
  arrange(date, site, transect, quadrat, organism_substrate) |>
  select(school, site, method, p1_or_p2, group,
         recorder, checker_1, checker_2,
         transect_points, organism_substrate, type, points, original_labels,
         date, latitude, longitude,
         number_of_transect_lines, length_of_transect_lines, point_spacing,
         number_of_quadrats_per_transect, transect, quadrat)

write_csv(opihi_2016, here("Mai","data","opihi16.csv"), na = "")

```

```{r}
#stack columns 

# Columns are the same in all three; date, latitude, longitude, the four transect-design
# fields, transect and quadrat are blank for the 2023 rows.
col_order <- c("school", "site", "method", "p1_or_p2", 
               "group", "recorder", "checker_1", "checker_2",
               "transect_points", "organism_substrate", 
               "type", "points", "original_labels",
               "date", "latitude", "longitude",
               "number_of_transect_lines", 
               "length_of_transect_lines", "point_spacing",
               "number_of_quadrats_per_transect", "transect", 
               "quadrat", "year")
 
opihi_master_all <- bind_rows(opihi_23_y, opihi_67_y, opihi_16_y) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
         school = recode(school, "OPIHI" = "OPIHI Coordinator", 
                         "Kilauea" = "Kilauea School"),
         organism_substrate = if_else(str_detect
                                      (organism_substrate, "^Sargassum"),
                                      "Sargassum spp", organism_substrate)) |>
  select(all_of(col_order)) |>
  # add points where two Sargassum names now share the same group/quadrat
  group_by(across(-c(points, original_labels))) |>
  summarise(points = sum(points),
            original_labels = paste(unique(original_labels), 
                                    collapse = "; "),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  select(all_of(col_order)) |>
  arrange(year, site, date, method, transect, quadrat, organism_substrate)


write_csv(opihi_master_all,here("Mai","data","opihi_master.csv"), na ="")
```
